description: Source code for get_helper.c, implementing helper functions for bbfdmd including transaction management, signal handling, and list operations.

methods.name: handle_pending_signal
methods.description: Handles pending signals, performs long jump or exits on unhandled signals.

methods.name: bbfdm_cmd_exec
methods.description: Executes a command within the bbfdm context, handling exceptions and faults.

methods.name: bb_add_string
methods.description: Adds a string parameter to a blob buffer.

methods.name: bbf_init
methods.description: Initializes the bbfdm context.

methods.name: bbf_cleanup
methods.description: Cleans up the bbfdm context.

methods.name: bbf_sub_init
methods.description: Initializes subscription-related context.

methods.name: bbf_sub_cleanup
methods.description: Cleans up subscription-related context.

methods.name: present_in_path_list
methods.description: Checks if an entry exists in a path list.

methods.name: add_pv_list
methods.description: Adds a parameter-value node to a list.

methods.name: free_pv_list
methods.description: Frees a list of parameter-value nodes.

methods.name: add_path_list
methods.description: Adds a path node to a list.

methods.name: free_path_list
methods.description: Frees a list of path nodes.

methods.name: fill_err_code_table
methods.description: Fills error code information into a blob message table.

methods.name: fill_err_code_array
methods.description: Fills error code information into a blob message array.

methods.name: transaction_timeout_handler
methods.description: Handles transaction timeout events, aborts transaction.

methods.name: get_random_id
methods.description: Generates a random transaction ID.

methods.name: CountConsecutiveDigits
methods.description: Counts consecutive digit characters in a string.

methods.name: compare_path
methods.description: Compares two path nodes for sorting, considering numeric parts.

methods.name: transaction_start
methods.description: Starts a new transaction, generating an ID and setting timeout.

methods.name: transaction_status
methods.description: Reports current transaction status.

methods.name: is_transaction_running
methods.description: Checks if a transaction is currently running.

methods.name: is_transaction_valid
methods.description: Validates if a given transaction ID matches the current one.

methods.name: transaction_commit
methods.description: Commits the current transaction if valid.

methods.name: transaction_abort
methods.description: Aborts the current transaction if valid.

methods.name: configure_transaction_timeout
methods.description: Sets the transaction timeout duration.

methods.name: sort_pv_path
methods.description: Returns a sorted array of parameter-value nodes based on path comparison.
